title: PHP 7.2.0 Released
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 7.2.0. This release marks the second feature update to the PHP 7 series.

PHP 7.2.0 comes with numerous improvements and new features such as

For source downloads of PHP 7.2.0 please visit our page Windows binaries can be found on the site. The list of changes is recorded in the .downloadsPHP for WindowsChangeLog

The is available in the PHP Manual. Please consult it for the detailed list of new features and backward incompatible changes.migration guide

Many thanks to all the contributors and supporters!

  • Convert numeric keys in object/array casts
  • Counting of non-countable objects
  • Object typehint
  • HashContext as Object
  • Argon2 in password hash
  • Improve TLS constants to sane values
  • Mcrypt extension removed
  • New sodium extension
